subject: Q4 handshake: TidalHealth term update & throughput uplift planning
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@tidalhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Q4 handshake: TidalHealth term update & throughput uplift planning

Alex —

Thanks for the time last week. As we discussed, TidalHealth is approaching both a term renewal (current agreement expires 2027-01-31) and a projected traffic uplift tied to your December pilot going live. I want to put a short kickoff thread in place so we have clear owners, a timeline, and a QBR window to lock in before the holidays.

High-level ask: confirm procurement timeline + nominate who owns the SOW review on your side.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Review attached Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — I filled in proposed milestones and dates.
- Confirm target term change (12 vs 24 months) and whether you want the standard staircase pricing or commit + burst.
- Lock a 30–45 minute QBR in the next 7–10 business days to walk capacity forecasts and the SOW.

Proposed timeline (subject to your procurement window):
- Week of Nov 29: internal review + QBR with execs (capacity & pricing)
- Week of Dec 6: SOW redline pass and procurement intake
- Week of Dec 13: Finalize term and capacity commit; engineering onboarding checklist

Attachments: TidalHealth_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners), Redwood_SOW_draft_TidalHealth.pdf (SOW draft — customer redline expected).

If you can share procurement point-of-contact and three 30–45 min slots, we’ll send a confirmed invite and owners.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@tidalhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@tidalhealth.org
Date: 2026-11-23T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q4 handshake: TidalHealth term update & throughput uplift planning

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Procurement lead is Priya Shah (procurement@tidalhealth.org) — looped.
- For term, our execs are leaning toward a 24-month commit if the pricing bands support predictable burst capacity. Can we model both 12- and 24-month scenarios in the QBR?
- We need the MAP to include a simple SLA callout for peak-hour latency for the pilot (expected ~3.5k RPS for a 90-minute window). Can Ben help with an initial capacity plan?

Availability for a brief QBR:
- Tue Nov 30, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed Dec 1, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Fri Dec 3, 09:00–09:45 PT

I’ll ask Priya to flag any contract redlines on the SOW and loop legal if needed.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Engineering — TidalHealth
alex.grant@tidalhealth.com | +1 206-555-0133

Alex —

I’ll own the capacity model and SLA callout. Short plan below and I’ve penciled approximate numbers for the Dec pilot window — happy to run the deeper perf checks with your infra team during the QBR.

Quick capacity snapshot (pilot expectations):
- Baseline: 800 RPS sustained (current usage)
- Pilot peak bursts: ~3.5k RPS for 60–90 mins (as you noted)
- Buffer plan: autoscale headroom for 5k RPS for safety, with warm nodes pre-provisioned for the launch window

I’ll prepare:
- Two price scenarios (12m vs 24m) with commit + burst delta and cost per million tokens
- Draft SLA paragraph for MAP & SOW (latency targets, scaling windows, incident response RTOs)
- Short runbook for on-call during pilot (2-hour visibility window)

Ben will push a capacity appendix to the MAP by EOD Nov 24. For the QBR slots Alex proposed, I can do Tue Nov 30 10:00 PT or Wed Dec 1 14:00 PT — either works.

Ben Carter
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the windows — I booked Tue Nov 30, 10:00–10:45 PT and sent a calendar invite titled "TidalHealth: Renewal + Pilot QBR" that includes a short agenda. Agenda items: 1) Capacity model + SLA (Ben), 2) Pricing scenarios (Soojin), 3) SOW questions and procurement timeline (Priya / Alex).

Action items we’ll cover in the QBR:
- Ben to deliver the capacity appendix in the MAP (EOD Nov 24) — attached to this thread.
- Priya to flag top 3 contract items for legal review ahead of the meeting.
- Soojin to present 12m vs 24m pricing scenarios and commit/burst options.

If anything changes on your side, reply with an updated procurement ETA. Otherwise we’ll use the QBR to validate term preference and aim to have a redline-ready SOW by Dec 6.

Best —
Marissa Cole
